en: Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kaito's room.
I don't have any business here right now.
Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>You had...no one.

<CLT=cltMIND>You found out that awful truth
and gave up your life for Kirumi.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...I...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma, you wanted to fight with us,
didn't you?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that not enough reason to live?

<CLT=cltMIND>You could've fought with us, we could've
fought together...then you could have lived.
<CLT=cltMIND>We...couldn't have been your reason to live?
...Maybe I'm just being arrogant.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is...Gonta's room, huh?
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kokichi's room, but...
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kiyo's room,
but I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Keebo's room...
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi's final moments... I can't get the image
of her running for her life out of my head.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can still hear her...
Her scream of defiance.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps running isn't so bad...
Perhaps we aren't strong enough to face it.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to live until the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Himiko's room.
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>So this is Maki's room...
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Tenko's room.
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is...Tsumugi's room.
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Angie's room, but...
I don't have any business here right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Miu's room,
but I don't have any business here right now.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
I suppose it's locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
